value.description: Transport of data between two classification schemes. Three equivalent views: (1) orthogonal Procrustes rotation R* = UV^T where M = Phi_B Phi_A^T = U Sigma V^T (Schoenemann 1966); (2) data migration functor Delta_F with adjoints Sigma_F |- Delta_F |- Pi_F (Spivak, arXiv:1009.1166); (3) geometric morphism f*|-f_* between classifying toposes (Sh(C',J') -> Sh(C,J)). Three-views-identity is the v3.10 proof obligation.

value.computation: completeness = |wires_present| / |wires_expected|. 'Expected' = wires predicated by the type's predicate algebra + its port declarations in the current ontology baseline.
open_questions: How is wires_expected computed? Candidate: port-schema closure under WF03-WF07 OWNS/GOVERNS/HAS_OBJECT_PART/CLASSIFIES/CARRIES
Should completeness be stored or computed at read-time? Storing risks staleness; computing costs O(|E|) per read
value.provenance: T=162 design note 20260326-fiber-decomposition.md (dynamic fiber, interface ports); T=168 IRL-to-HG pipeline note §7.1 (Little's Law backpressure as dual)
value.semantics: A fiber (minimal coherent subgraph for an operation) is complete when all predicted wires are materialized. Below threshold -> emit bridge-sync event (dynamic-fibre decomposition, T=162 salvage).
value.trigger: when completeness < configured_threshold (default 0.8), emit event on WF17 watcher 'bridge.sync.needed' with fiber_urn + missing_wires array

value.composition_with_spectral: Jost-Liu 2014: kappa >= kappa_min => lambda_2(L) >= kappa_min. Use Ollivier to *locate* bottleneck edges; use lambda_2 of branchial Laplacian to *quantify* global throttle (Cheeger h^2/2 <= lambda_2 <= 2h).

forman_ricci.note: Cheap combinatorial proxy, O(deg) per edge vs Ollivier's O(deg^3)/LP. Use for screening at scale; Ollivier on top-k candidates. Spearman 0.7-0.9 correlation on real networks (Samal 2018).

ollivier_ricci.definition: W_1 = Wasserstein-1 (Earth Mover) distance between lazy-random-walk neighbor measures; d = graph distance. Ollivier 2007, Lin-Lu-Yau 2011.
ollivier_ricci.semantics: kappa < 0 -> bottleneck (mass squeezes through bridge); kappa > 0 -> information diffuses cheaply.

value.provenance: T=162 design note 20260326-fiber-decomposition.md; T=168 IRL-to-HG pipeline note §7.2
value.ricci_flow: Iterate w_e^{t+1} = w_e^t * (1 - epsilon * kappa(e)). Ni et al. 2019 (Nature Sci Rep): negatively-curved edges stretch, positively-curved shrink; communities emerge as positively-curved clusters. Outperforms modularity (no resolution limit).
value.usage: Compute on the branchial graph (kernel-quotient): nodes=kernel fibers, edges=twin_link bundles. kappa << threshold triggers re-decomposition + bridge rate adjustment.

value.formula: rho(C) < threshold where C = T * P cascade matrix, T = watcher->reactor topology adjacency, P = diag(per-node propagation gain)
value.provenance: T=162 design note 20260408-reactive-topology-t158.md (cascade matrix first proposed); T=168 IRL-to-HG pipeline note §7.1
references: Barrat-Barthelemy-Vespignani 'Dynamical Processes on Complex Networks' 2008 ch.9
Wang et al. IEEE SRDS 2003 (rho(A) < 1/beta -> die-out)
value.semantics: Refuses a watcher-reactor pair that would push the cascade matrix past stability threshold. Replaces the current WF17 runtime depth-1 cutoff with a configuration-time guarantee. Convergence theorem: rho(C) < 1 => lim_n C^n x = 0.

value.applies_to: post-twin_link sync; federation consistency check (§M9 twin_link extension)
value.composition_with_ricci: Jost-Liu 2014 gives kappa -> lambda_2 bound. High-curvature bridges (negative Ollivier-Ricci on twin_link, §v310-4) are candidate localizations of sheaf_laplacian non-zero spectrum. v3.10 proof obligation: tie the two.
value.formula: L_F = delta* delta. Consistency holds iff ker(L_F) has the expected dimension. Non-zero eigenvalues measure local-to-global disagreement.

params.kernel_quotient_urn: URN of the branchial graph node carrying the quotient structure
params.tolerance: float epsilon, default 1e-6; eigenvalues below are treated as numerical zero

references: Hansen-Ghrist 'Toward a Spectral Theory of Cellular Sheaves' J Appl Comput Topol 2019, arXiv:1808.01513
value.returns: bool (any eigenvalue > tolerance) + optional diagnostic (largest eigenvalue + its eigenvector localising the inconsistency)
value.semantics: Detects federation inconsistency mechanically: no hand-rolled reconciliation code. Non-zero eigenvector identifies WHICH stalk disagrees with its neighbours. Replaces ad-hoc twin_link consistency checks.
value.setup: Model the federation as a cellular sheaf F on the kernel-quotient graph G: stalk F(k) = each kernel's local HG; restriction maps F(k -> bridge) project shared URNs onto the bridge edge. Global section = consistent federated HG view.

value.semantics: Scalar UI prefs held by the session for its occupant's t-cone rendering. Non-topological — anything topological (pins, filters) is carried by relations (D19.3, D19.4). Distinct from view_filter (a saved predicate); view_prefs is how the filtered result is displayed.

Occupant's pinned references — any node the occupant wants persistently visible in their t-cone regardless of filter predicates. Rewrites to session.pins-urn LINK use ADD/UNLINK; cardinality unbounded; ordering carried by an optional pin_order property on the LINK (owner mutable).
value.wf_id: candidate-new-WF (or extend WF19 mutate_scope with a pin-LINK subcategory)

value.semantics: Binds a session to one or more view_filter nodes whose predicates narrow its t-cone. Evaluation order: intersection (all predicates must hold). §M15 t-cone composition: t-cone(session, T) = { n ∈ open_hooks(T) ∩ WF02_visible(session.occupant) | ∀ vf ∈ session.filtered-by. vf.predicate(n) }.
value.wf_id: candidate-new-WF (semantic port; distinct from WF18 structural composes)

value.semantics: Binds an agent (as tool) into a session's tool-registry. Mounted tools are invokable by the occupant per their WF02 capabilities. Tool invocation produces tool_call interaction nodes (existing); the mount relation is the enabling fact. UNLINK unmounts.
value.wf_id: candidate extension to WF02 (capability-scoped) or new WF

value.semantics: Declares the execution environment (harness, S2 v3.9 type) an agent runs under. Multiplicity: one agent may run in at most one harness at a time (constrained by harness.current_agent cardinality=1). Harness change = MUTATE LINK target_urn. CI note: agent's capability set is intersected with harness.allowed_capabilities at runtime.

Recursive tool-making: an agent produces another agent. Essential for tools-that-make-tools (Claude CLI as canonical first mount). Cardinality: unbounded (one agent can construct many). CI-invariant (candidate CI-6): capability isolation — constructor's capabilities do NOT auto-inherit to constructed; each constructed agent's capability set is declared explicitly at LINK time, intersected with constructor's as an upper bound. Prevents privilege escalation through recursive construction.

Adding after_urn needs a node-property lookup at evaluation time. all_of is pure boolean composition. Small patch; tracked as t187.reactive-engine sub-program target_t=205.

part_a_property.semantics: Set by a canonical startable t_hook (see part B) when: (a) T-counter >= program.starts_t, AND (b) every depends-on program has status in terminal-ok set {completed}. Acts as the 'ready to actually begin' signal separate from draft (not yet scheduled) and active (running).

part_b_predicate_shape.dependent_program_case: all_of with fires_at + one after_urn per dependency. All must hold simultaneously.
part_b_predicate_shape.independent_program_case: No after_urn clauses — arity-1 (just fires_at). Fires as soon as T-counter ticks past starts_t.

value.provenance: T=168 round 8 plan delivery D4; this is the 'ready to start' signal the t-cone needs to surface actionable items without an external scheduler.
value.round_8_materialisation: This round ADDs 2 startable t_hooks for v310-delivery and wiring-proposer (the two new successor programs from Batch B). The 6 active T=187 sub-program startable t_hooks are deferred until the reactive engine's predicate evaluator implements all_of / after_urn semantics.
